question.problem:
Solve the following system of equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}3.5a-4.5b-8=0 \\ 0.6a-1.2b-1.8=0\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
To get rid of the decimals, we multiply both equations by $10,$ as follows:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}3.5a-4.5b-8=0 & |\,\times 10 \\ 0.6a-1.2b-1.8=0 & |\,\times 10\end{aligned}\,⟹\,\{\begin{aligned}35a-45b-80=0 \\ 6a-12b-18=0\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that we can solve for $a$ in the second equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}6a-12b-18 & =0 \\ 6a & =12b+18 \\ a & =\frac{12b+18}{6} \\ a & =2b+3\end{aligned}
$$

Now, to find the value of $b,$ we can substitute $a=2b+3$ into the first equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}35a-45b-80 & =0 \\ 35(2b+3)-45b-80 & =0 \\ 70b+105-45b-80 & =0 \\ 25b+25 & =0 \\ 25b & =-25 \\ b & =-1\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute $b=-1$ into the equation $a=2b+3$ to get:

$$
\begin{aligned}a & =2b+3 \\ a & =2(-1)+3 \\ a & =-2+3 \\ a & =1\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to the system of equations is $a=1,\,b=-1.$
